reading: status is the state now. auditFinding is what the audit found before a fix; fixedBy is the commit or packet that fixed it. A row found as GAP_SAFE_TO_FIX and fixed reads SATISFIED.

rows.requirement: Detect whether a real browser or session executor exists before building a watchdog
rows.note: NOT_CURRENTLY_APPLICABLE_NO_BROWSER_EXECUTOR. Checked again on 2026-10-02: no Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium or WebDriver dependency and no session executor in the source. Trigger: a browser or session executor registers an activity; then bind session identity and last progress to the existing journal, with no second recovery engine.

rows.requirement: Durable identities, bounded retry, inspect and reread first, no blind replay, uncertainty never becomes success
rows.note: The task, attempt, idempotency key and exact target are durable; the sweep rereads before anything, reports OVERDUE, stale and UNCERTAIN tasks without replay, and a side effect it cannot prove ends UNCERTAIN. The addendum's session fields (sessionId, lastProgressAt) and its classification names are for a session executor that does not exist.

rows.requirement: Whole-prompt budget: known window, reply reserve, deterministic trimming, protected retention, refusal when the mandatory part does not fit

Limits: the size is an estimate that has not been compared with the real tokenizer (the local transport's measured prompt size is checked after each reply); id-level budget evidence is not durably stored; pipeline and research model calls use a different provider and are not budgeted.
